run_program_with_timeout: run a program via subprocess with a configurable timeout and parse its score output
evaluate_program: evaluate a program by submitting it to an online judge and return performance metrics
test_run_with_timeout: test the run_with_timeout function by running a program with a custom timeout value
review_evaluate: review the evaluate function to understand how it computes combined scores from test results
refactor_run_with_timeout: refactor run_with_timeout to support additional programming languages beyond Python 3
